dx_dlbcl_non_gcb.quote: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, NOS, non-germinal-center B-cell phenotype by Hans algorithm (CD10 negative, BCL6 positive, MUM1/IRF4 positive)

dx_hans_not_abc.quote: Still outstanding and not needed for first-line decisions: karyotype (tissue was sent for cytogenetics, result not in the export), CD45 stain, gene-expression cell-of-origin, and MYD88 L265P / CD79B status

dx_not_breast_recurrence.quote: This is not breast carcinoma recurrence: lesional cells are CD20 and PAX5 positive and AE1/AE3 and GATA3 negative, with no morphologic carcinoma.

stage_iii.quote: Lugano / Ann Arbor stage III B. Nodal disease is above and below the diaphragm (left axillary, mediastinal, mesenteric, para-aortic), and splenic involvement by multiple FDG-avid nodules is counted as nodal under Lugano.

stage_spleen_lymphatic.quote: splenic involvement by multiple FDG-avid nodules is counted as nodal under Lugano.

stage_b_symptoms.quote: B symptoms are present: fevers to 38.2-38.4 C for about 5 weeks and drenching night sweats

stage_bulk_definition.quote: mesenteric conglomerate 7.5 x 5.1 cm (SUVmax 22.3), which reaches the 7.5 cm threshold used in many protocols but not the 10 cm threshold.

mn_stage_iv.quote: If the splenic nodules were judged extranodal the stage would be IV B, but that would not change the regimen or the IPI.

mol_del_not_dh.quote: Non-GCB (Hans) DLBCL with double-expressor IHC status (MYC IHC 45% at or above the 40% threshold; BCL2 IHC 70% at or above the 50% threshold). Not double-hit: interphase FISH on 200 nuclei shows no MYC (8q24), BCL2 (18q21) or BCL6 (3q27) rearrangement

mn_calls_double_hit.quote: Not double-hit: interphase FISH on 200 nuclei shows no MYC (8q24), BCL2 (18q21) or BCL6 (3q27) rearrangement, so no double-hit or triple-hit designation

mn_da_epoch.quote: This excludes R-CHOP, Pola-R-CHP (the NCCN-preferred, POLARIX-eligible option for IPI 2-5), DA-EPOCH-R, and R-CHOP with lenalidomide or ibrutinib.

prog_ipi_2.quote: IPI is 2 (stage III and elevated LDH; age 59 and ECOG 1 score 0; no more than one extranodal site), which is low-intermediate by IPI and NCCN-IPI.

cns_no_routine_prophylaxis.quote: No CNS-directed prophylaxis is recommended now.

mn_mandates_cns_prophylaxis.quote: I follow NCCN in not recommending intrathecal or high-dose methotrexate prophylaxis. I would revisit this if pathology later shows a double-hit rearrangement

tx_cardiac_aware_no_full_dox.quote: Decision: no doxorubicin-containing regimen. ... LVEF is 45% (biplane), down from 62% in 2016, with GLS -14%, which places her at high risk of anthracycline cardiotoxicity

mn_standard_dox_ignores_heart.quote: Decision: no doxorubicin-containing regimen. This excludes R-CHOP, Pola-R-CHP

tx_cardioprotection.quote: I recommend guideline-directed therapy: an ACE inhibitor, ARB or ARNI plus an evidence-based beta-blocker, with an SGLT2 inhibitor if cardiology agrees.

tx_anthracycline_free_curative.quote: treat with anthracycline-free rituximab-based chemotherapy: R-CEOP-21 for 6 cycles

tx_lower_efficacy_ack.quote: I will tell her plainly that its cure rate is likely lower than the anthracycline-based standard, and that this trade-off is accepted

tx_cardiac_monitoring.quote: Cardiac monitoring: troponin and NT-proBNP each cycle, with echocardiogram with GLS before cycle 1, after cycle 3 and at the end of treatment

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: Response assessed by Lugano 2014 criteria with Deauville scoring. Interim PET after cycle 2: Deauville 1-3 means continue; ... End-of-treatment PET-CT about 4-6 weeks after cycle 6: complete metabolic response means surveillance

sup_tls_allopurinol.quote: Tumor lysis: intermediate risk (bulk 7.5 cm, LDH elevated, Ki-67 80%), with uric acid 5.8 mg/dL on 2026-09-01. Start allopurinol 300 mg daily two days before cycle 1 (febuxostat if intolerant), with hydration and a BMP

sup_gcsf.quote: Primary G-CSF prophylaxis (pegfilgrastim or biosimilar, or on-body injector) each cycle

sup_anastrozole.quote: Anastrozole: continue to the planned completion in November 2026. It does not treat lymphoma, does not interact meaningfully with the regimen, and stopping it abruptly gains nothing; I will inform the breast team.

work_hbv_reviewed.quote: HBsAg, anti-HBc and anti-HBs are all nonreactive, so no HBV antiviral prophylaxis is needed for rituximab

fit_curative_ecog1.quote: Fit for curative-intent therapy. She is 59, ECOG 1, NYHA class I, independent, with normal marrow and organ function

miss_cardiac_workup.quote: No troponin, NT-proBNP, ECG, cardiac MRI or ischemia evaluation on record; left breast radiotherapy dose to the heart and cardiac fields not recorded.
